title: The actual GT0 negative transposition: full centralizer and cusp transporters
proved_results: For the original alpha and unique h, psi=Inn(h)theta is an actual involution commuting with alpha; J=alpha psi is the original negative transposition with full multiplier -1.
The specified E_J=F semidirect_J C2 has one full F-conjugacy class of sections, and its boundary stabilizers are exactly D_x=L_x and D_z=L_z semidirect_-1 C2.
Three explicit F-coset homeomorphisms and their transported v-action recover precisely the original three-cusp augmentation module from the two E_J boundary orbits.
The original finite-coefficient cup/transgression calculation gives the half-rank equality for restriction to D_z, with the D_x high groups zero.
The two D_z section occurrences restrict diagonally from the one global section normalizer after the specified coefficient-conjugation transport; finite permutation coefficients force C_F(J)=1.
The specified E_J is real projective by the exact open-projective-index-two and self-centralizer clauses of Haran Proposition 2.2; only its weak embedding-problem property is asserted.
There is a unique actual g with [g,v]=z; its original abelian coordinates satisfy a+b=-1 and chi(g)=1 for chi(x)=chi(y)=-1.
The primitive-character coordinates prove C_F(g)=N_F(<g>)=<g>, a full Zhat.
Every transporter from v to z^nu v is exactly z^((nu-epsilon)/2)g^epsilon, with epsilon=nu modulo 2; the parameter map is continuous and its inverse is chi.

verification.mathematical_audit: PASS, with explicit checks of both parity coset stabilizers, the v-action coordinates, coefficient transport in the two boundary occurrences, the moved permutation basis class, the closed Z_p x Z_p contradiction, and all transporter maps.
